source_kind: Identical Rust-generated WebAssembly per profile; opt-level 0 and 3 are different input modules
tool_scope: Pinned x86-64 Wasmtime CLI Cranelift with experimental i64 unsigned udiv+imul+isub to multi-result udivrem; exact adjacent same-block SSA match

verdict.ci: Both source-controls and identical-rust-wasm jobs success
verdict.finite_producer: 569 value + 79 trap/panic cases per compiler per profile (648 x 4 = 2592 executions); all passed
verdict.finite_rechecker: 984 fresh executions; independent arithmetic oracle and SHA/cost checks passed
verdict.formal_equivalence: NOT a full compiler-pass, machine-ISA or flag/ABI/poison proof; no all-64-bit SMT result claimed
verdict.exhaustive_small_model: Independent 8-bit unsigned nonzero-divisor Python check passed all 65,280 pairs (mathematical identity, not Cranelift execution)

native_code_bytes.interpretation: Number of decoded instruction bytes printed by wasmtime objdump per function, NOT CLIF cost, whole AOT size, nor necessarily ELF symbol size. prefix = instructions through first retq, all = all printed instructions including cold trap tails.

profile_optimized.observed_static_divq: 6 baseline / 6 patched module-wide, since one division is already present per matching function
profile_optimized.observed_imulq_and_subq: Each of the 3 positive functions removes one imulq and one subq; there are four fewer decoded instructions per positive function
profile_optimized.ELF_text_bytes: 28672 baseline and patched (page-aligned section size unchanged)
profile_optimized.cost_limitations: No runtime speedup benchmark; no whole-AOT size reduction; bytes are per-function emitted listing only

scope_and_caveats: Source-backed optimizer reachability established for only three deliberately constructed optimized Rust functions. This is not a prevalence study.
Intermediate CLIF imul retained by patch for conservative possible other consumers; dead native code disappeared after lowering.
Diff was found in the raw emitted code under identical Rust Wasm; signed, swapped-operand and quotient-only controls unchanged
The earlier adjacent udiv/urem optimization did not trigger for these Rust inputs; this is a new shape
Standalone arithmetic identity does not prove all compiler/SSA/register-pressure/flag/poison cases
No upstream Wasmtime PR, main branch mutation, or production deployment
